title: The Siege of Caffa
sentences: In 1346, an army hurled dead bodies over a city wall.
The city was Caffa, a Genoese trading port on the Black Sea.
The Mongol army besieging it was dying of plague.
According to one writer of the time, they catapulted the corpses inside.
Some historians think ships fleeing Caffa helped carry the disease to Europe.
